basics.name: Wyatt Walsh
basics.label: Senior AI/ML Engineer
basics.summary: Senior AI/ML engineer building production agentic AI systems, LLM applications, data platforms, and developer tooling for regulated fintech and enterprise teams.

work.name: Frame Payments
work.summary: Served as the sole AI/ML Engineer delivering production agentic AI, LLM document intelligence, and multimodal compliance automation for risk/compliance and growth at a high risk merchant payments platform, with human-in-the-loop UX and audit-aware handling of PII and confidential documents.
highlights: Deployed an LLM document classification workflow using PydanticAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Claude, surfaced as in-browser feedback for confidential uploads; reduced analyst follow-ups and resubmission requests ~90% by blocking miscategorized documents before review.

Built restricted-item compliance screening that combines product images with structured submission metadata; translated banking-partner policy requirements into automated checks supporting onboarding across tens of merchants, multi-location operations, and catalogs with hundreds of items per location.

Built a NotebookLM-based technical knowledge hub spanning vendor/web documentation and internal monorepo docs; automated corpus refresh with a Colab pipeline that re-ingests the latest sources to keep retrieval accurate and up to date.

Drove internal AI adoption with practical enablement assets: Notion playbooks covering MCP onboarding, “best MCPs” recommendations, and high-signal prompt patterns; ran weekly office hours reaching ~15% of the company and standardized PII/confidential-document safeguards and auditability requirements.

work.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
work.position: Associate III, Senior Software Engineer - Data Integrations
work.summary: Engineered enterprise-grade data pipelines, data integrations, and analytics solutions for trading, quantitative research, and risk groups within the credit division of the investment bank and fostered improved AI development tool usage across the firm.
highlights: Pioneered firm-wide rollout of generative AI development tools (LLMs, GitHub Copilot, Codeium) as one of the first 500 engineers, delivering feedback that shaped secure, scalable deployment and leading internal workshops to boost productivity for technical and non-technical teams.
Devised ML-driven anomaly detection framework for data health monitoring, reducing false positives by 25% and cutting manual review time, empowering risk teams to focus on critical alerts.
Developed resilient Python wrapper for KDB+, democratizing data access for 5,000+ users with CI-style tests and optimized Q functions, reducing manual processing by over 10 hours per week.

Engineered a cloud-function-driven asset-fee data sink, consolidating 10+ sources into a centralized database, cutting manual maintenance by 90% and providing on-demand access for traders through a Python SDK, REST API, and interactive dashboard.

work.name: Stealth Web3 Startup
work.summary: Delivered an advanced DeFi DApp as the founding engineer, integrating ethers.js for gas-optimized web3 smart contract interactions, implementing CI/CD and TDD pipelines to boost development efficiency, and partnering with founders to translate Figma designs into pixel-perfect interfaces.
highlights: Architected a scalable NFT-collateralized lending DApp using React, Next.js, TypeScript, MobX, and ethers.js, enabling secure, performant on-chain loans.
Implemented end-to-end CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Husky, Cypress, and Jest to halve release cycles and raise test coverage to 90%, while mentoring a front-end intern to build key UI components.
Optimized front-end performance through code splitting, lazy loading, and asset caching, reducing initial load times by 40% and JavaScript bundle size by 30%.

work.name: SandLabs
work.summary: Enabled better data-driven decision making for Web3 stakeholders by tokenizing a 1M+ post/comment, Web3-related Reddit dataset onto a decentralized data marketplace after creating a public-facing web app and securing grant funding to enable the project.
highlights: Engineered and launched a Next.js/TailwindCSS marketing site with top-tier Lighthouse scores and secured $75K in OCEAN tokens via a competitive DAO grant.
Engineered Python pipelines to extract and normalize a 1M+ Web3-related Reddit posts & comments dataset and published the data on Ocean Protocol’s Data Marketplace.

work.name: Gap Inc.
work.summary: Completed a senior-semester extern/capstone with Gap Inc.'s demand forecasting team, leading the data engineering and forecasting workflows that improved forecast accuracy by 5-25% for inventory planning across multiple retail divisions.
highlights: Applied time-series decomposition and bias correction techniques to demand forecasts, boosting accuracy by up to 25% and minimizing surplus inventory costs.

Owned the data engineering layer by architecting scalable MySQL and Apache Spark pipelines across 5+ years of sales data, improving data processing throughput by 95% and standardizing insights across forecasting teams.

projects.name: AI Agent Harness Configs
projects.description: Open-source agent tooling catalog and docs portal packaging reusable skills, configs, and MCP-ready workflows across Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, and related runtimes.
highlights: Built 40+ reusable instruction and skill packs plus shared harness configs that install across Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and related agent runtimes.
Shipped generated docs, install flows, and portable tool and MCP presets for code review, security, infrastructure, research, and workflow automation.

projects.name: NBA Basketball Database
projects.description: Open-source NBA analytics warehouse and dataset covering 65K+ games and 13M+ play-by-play events, with a CLI, docs site, and Kaggle distribution for reproducible sports analysis.
highlights: Implemented a high-performance, validated ETL pipeline that extracts from the NBA API, updates warehouse outputs daily, and exports DuckDB, SQLite, Parquet, and CSV artifacts.
Built the surrounding product surface with docs, schema references, release workflows, and Kaggle distribution that pushed the dataset past 400K views and 45K downloads.

projects.name: Listentropy
projects.description: Privacy-first Spotify listening analytics app that processes Extended Streaming History entirely client-side and turns it into rich dashboards, share cards, and exploratory views without sending personal data to a server.
highlights: Architected a Web Worker processing pipeline with stage-level progress tracking that handles full streaming history datasets in-browser, keeping all personal listening data local.
Built a Share Studio with 14-card presets and PNG/ZIP export, plus a theme system with 4 visual modes and strict performance budgets (<450 KiB bootstrap, <300 KiB async chunks).

projects.name: ProxyWhirl
projects.description: Released rotating proxy toolkit with 9 selection strategies, 100+ auto-validated sources, and self-healing health checks for resilient scraping and data-collection workflows.
highlights: Implemented 9 rotation strategies (round-robin, weighted, geo-targeted, performance-based, and more) with configurable fallback chains and per-source health scoring.
Built a self-healing pipeline that continuously validates 100+ built-in proxy sources, auto-ejects unresponsive proxies via circuit breakers, and re-promotes recovered sources.

projects.name: Personal Website: w4w.dev
projects.description: Long-running personal web app and MDX publishing system built with Next.js, combining a polished public-facing frontend with a richly tooled technical blog, strong SEO, and durable content workflows.
highlights: Designed and maintained the public product surface across multiple generations, including responsive landing experiences, theme support, motion, and accessibility-conscious UI polish.
Built a deeply customized MDX publishing workflow with search, metadata, math rendering, feeds, tags, and other authoring features usually split across several separate tools.

projects.name: MDXPad
projects.description: Native macOS desktop editor for Markdown and MDX with live synchronized preview, multi-provider AI integration (Anthropic, OpenAI, custom endpoints), and secure credential storage via macOS Keychain.
highlights: Built a dual-format editor on Electron 39 + CodeMirror 6 with synchronized scroll between source and rendered preview, remark/rehype plugin support, and YAML frontmatter validation.
Integrated multi-provider AI assistance with bring-your-own-key support, per-provider token/cost tracking, and Keychain-backed secret storage.

projects.name: MCP-Crawl4AI
projects.description: Released FastMCP server wrapping Crawl4AI so AI agents can crawl and extract web content through four focused tools, agent-friendly outputs, tagged releases, and documented stdio/HTTP integration paths.
highlights: Built a FastMCP v3 server with lifespan-managed headless Chromium, session-aware crawling workflows, and automatic Playwright browser setup—only 2 runtime dependencies.
Exposed 4 tools, 2 resources, and 3 prompt templates with both stdio and HTTP transport, backed by docs, tests, and release-tagged install flows for MCP-compatible agents.

projects.name: IINA Bookmarks Plugin
projects.description: Advanced bookmark management plugin for the IINA media player featuring multi-interface design (sidebar, standalone window, video overlay), tag-based organization, and file reconciliation for moved or renamed media.
highlights: Engineered three complementary interfaces—sidebar tab, detached window, and in-video overlay—with a shared tag system supporting auto-tagging and multi-criteria filtering.
Implemented JSON/CSV import-export with duplicate handling and intelligent file reconciliation that resolves bookmarks when media files are moved or renamed.

projects.name: FL Studio MCP Server
projects.description: Built an alpha MCP platform for FL Studio with a large typed tool surface, resources-first contracts, transaction-safe mutations, and a docs-backed monorepo for AI-assisted music production workflows.
highlights: Defined 196 FL Studio tools plus core governance tools, with read paths exposed through typed resources and mutations funneled through a transaction pipeline.
Backed the alpha with a Python MCP runtime, a Next.js + Fumadocs docs portal, a plugin bundle, and 655+ tests covering contracts, unit paths, and integration scenarios.

projects.name: AI/ML Web Feeds
projects.description: Built a curated AI and ML feed platform with a typed feed schema, automated validation, contributor submission workflows, and docs-backed browse and download surfaces.
highlights: Defined a structured YAML feed schema with topic classification (ML, NLP, CV, etc.) and source-type validation (blog, paper, newsletter) to ensure feed quality at scale.
Shipped helper scripts, CI checks, scheduled validation jobs, and a live docs surface so community-submitted feeds can be reviewed, normalized, and published reliably.

projects.name: Regularized Linear Regression Deep Dive
projects.description: Open-sourced a theory-to-practice deep dive on regularized linear models—Ridge, Lasso, Elastic Net—derived from first principles in NumPy, validated on a wine-quality dataset, and narrated through a three-part Towards Data Science series read by 15K+ data scientists.
highlights: Authored an in-depth, three-part article series on Towards Data Science demystifying regularized regression, which amassed over 20,000 views and established credibility in the data science community.
Developed custom, vectorized NumPy implementations of Ridge, Lasso, and Elastic Net, including a Pathwise Coordinate Descent solver, achieving performance comparable to scikit-learn.
